_comment_name: EXT-006: scoped to @72street/. An UNSCOPED internal name that is unclaimed on the public registry is a standing dependency-confusion foothold — any build or CI that resolves this name against public npm would fetch whatever a squatter published under it. A scope the org controls removes that: @72street/venty-frontend cannot be published by anyone else once the scope is reserved. Renaming is safe here because nothing imports this package by name; it is the app root, not a library. Remaining (registry-side, not code): publicly reserve the @72street scope on npm, and configure any internal registry to PROXY public npm rather than run dual-endpoint resolution.
name: @72street/venty-frontend
